items.text: Elizabeth “Liz” Doody Gorman served as Cook County Commissioner for the 17th District from 2002 to 2015. She later was executive director of the Illinois Tollway and was appointed to the Regional Transportation Authority board in 2021. As commissioner, she led an effort to roll back the county sales tax from 1.75% to 1.25%.

She later was executive director of the Illinois Tollway and was appointed to the Regional Transportation Authority board in 2021.
As commissioner, she led an effort to roll back the county sales tax from 1.75% to 1.25%.

items.text: Her 2026 campaign emphasizes protecting taxpayers, accountable government, public safety, and services for seniors. During her 2022 campaign, she said she had never voted for a tax increase. During that race, she criticized policies she said allowed violent criminals to be released and contributed to crime in the suburbs.
